title: Rich-history reconstruction and historical row-count differences
population: Publicly reconstructed and historical rich-history training and validation materializations.
metric: Public reconstruction minus historical horizon-row count.
sample_sizes: Training 15,134 publicly reconstructed vs 15,182 historical rows; validation 3,799 vs 3,795.
uncertainty: Not applicable; these are recorded membership counts, not response estimates.
caption_tex: The figure compares publicly reconstructed and historical rich-history materializations by training and validation split. The horizontal axis gives the difference in horizon-row count (public reconstruction minus historical record). Training contains 15,134 publicly reconstructed rows and 15,182 historical rows, a difference of −48. Validation contains 3,799 publicly reconstructed rows and 3,795 historical rows, a difference of +4. These counts describe membership differences in the preserved splits. They are not response effects or uncertainty intervals.
